name: lunge_in
prompt: Slow motion. From his guard he performs one single fencing lunge toward the right: the front foot steps forward and the rapier arm extends straight forward, ending at full extension.

name: lunge_out
prompt: Slow motion. From full lunge extension he recovers straight back into his guard stance: the front foot comes back and the rapier arm bends back to guard.

name: shot_in
prompt: Slow motion. He raises the pistol across his chest and extends the arm to aim to the right.

name: shot_fire
prompt: Slow motion. The pistol fires and the recoil pushes his pistol arm up and back.

name: shot_out
prompt: Slow motion. He lowers the pistol down to his hip and settles back into his guard stance.
